final: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment AS e2 JOIN sites AS s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = e2.zoneref) AS imgcount_diff_from_overall FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat
